items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: No, I never, in fact, never did hear Trombone, or Bill played a drum, but I know he could.

ctx.x: What did Bill Matthews play then? Trombone.
Trombone. Who? Bill. No, I never, in fact, never did hear Trombone, or Bill played a drum, but I know he could.
